doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing investigative records and photographic evidence regarding a 1947 UFO sighting in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

incidents.summary: W. R. Presley photographed a flying saucer over Oak Ridge, Tennessee, while taking pictures of his house and the mountain.
incidents.quote: This, however, is the first time that one has ever been photographed over Oak Ridge.
